{{Quote|On Dravione I learn that aeries once frequented by Xim and his court still await atop the jagged peaks, preserved in the dry chill.|Bleys Harand, ''Travels Amid Strange Stars''|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
'''Dravione''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster's]] [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]]. At some point between approximately [[25,150 BBY]] and [[25,130 BBY]], it was seized by the [[Xer's Campaigns|expanding]] [[Kingdom of Argai]] led by the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] chieftain [[Xer VIII]]. Under the [[Xim's empire|reign]] of Xer's [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], Dravione was the site of several [[Dravione aeries|aeries]] built atop [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] peaks that were frequented by the younger [[King of Cron|ruler]] and his court. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, Dravione was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]] on which the still-preserved aeries were at one point visited by the traveling [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]], and [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Bleys Harand]].

==Description==
Dravione was a bleak [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="Xim" /> located in the [[Dravione system/Legends|Dravione system]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was a part of the [[Allied Tion sector/Legends|Allied Tion sector]] of the [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]],<ref name="Xim" /> situated within [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="The Slice" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> Dravione was situated at the junction of three [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace routes]]: the [[Cadinth Run]] and the [[Desevran Trace]], which linked it to the [[Jaminere system/Legends|Jaminere]] and [[Corlax system/Legends|Corlax systems]], respectively, and the [[Indrexu Route]], which connected it to the [[Argai system/Legends|Argai system]] in the [[Cronese Mandate/Legends|Cronese Mandate]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Xim" /> Dravione's surface featured a number of jagged [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] peaks that were exposed to<ref name="Author's Cut" /> thin,<ref name="Xim" /> dry, and [[Temperature/Legends|chilly]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==History==
{{Quote|Where is the rest of the statue? The guide shrugs, not even bothering with so meager a reply when asked if the statue is Xim.|Bleys Harand, ''Travels Amid Strange Stars''|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
[[File:Kingdom_of_Argai.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Dravione became the first world to be seized by the expanding Kingdom of Argai.]]
At some point between approximately [[25,150 BBY]] and [[25,130 BBY]], Dravione was [[Xer's Campaigns|seized]] by the forces of [[Xer VIII]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] chieftain and the [[Lord/Legends|lord]] of the planet [[Argai]], thus becoming a part of the [[Kingdom of Argai]], a pocket realm Xer carved out of the [[Kingdom of Cron]]. Within a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] of Xer's expansion throughout local [[Realspace/Legends|space]], his realm stretched from Dravione to the [[Panna system/Legends|Panna system]]. After the ascension to the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] of the [[Cronese]] [[King of Cron|King]] [[Xim/Legends|Xim]], Xer's [[Gender/Legends|son]] who expanded his [[Parent/Legends|father's]] realm into a vast [[Xim's empire|empire]],<ref name="Xim" /> in 25,130 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> a number of [[Dravione aeries|aeries]] were established on Dravione<ref name="Xim" /> that were frequented by the younger [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] ruler and his court.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

Over the subsequent [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]], Dravione, which served as an [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural world]], was eclipsed by the nearby, powerful manufacturing world [[Jaminere/Legends|Jaminere]].<ref name="Xim" /> By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], a ruined [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] on Dravione represented as a faded [[holograph]] at the booths of the [[Orman's Sky Palace]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] on the planet [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], one of the establishment's several such recreations of sights from the Allied Tion sector worlds.<ref name="Lianna" />

The [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]], and [[Historian/Legends|historian]]<ref name="Xim" /> [[Bleys Harand]] at one point traveled to the worlds of the Tion Cluster in search of a contemporary visual depiction of Xim. On Dravione,<ref name="Author's Cut" /> he<ref name="Xim" /> visited one of the world's preserved aeries, noticing the remains of a statue in a courtyard there that his guide could not confirm as depicting Xim. Harand later mentioned Dravione in a travelogue, ''[[Travels Amid Strange Stars]]'', he [[Author/Legends|authored]] about his voyage to the Tion.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|But even the most promising one is empty – empty save for a courtyard where stands a pedestal and feet, ankles and calves of stone.|Bleys Harand, ''Travels Amid Strange Stars''|<ref name="Author's Cut" />}}
A ruined fortress was located on Dravione.<ref name="Lianna" /> The world was also the site of a number of aeries situated atop mountain peaks, where they were preserved by the atmospheric conditions for millennia. One of the aeries featured a courtyard with the remains of a [[Stone/Legends|stone]] statue depicting a person.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Mission_to_Lianna.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The first mention of Dravione was in ''Mission to Lianna''.]]
Dravione was introduced in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', a [[1992]] [[West End Games]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure authored by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]].<ref name="Lianna" /> The [[December 7]], [[2009]], [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]<ref name="XimOriginal">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/source/ximweek01/index.html|text=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref> article "[[Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster]]" by [[Jason Fry]] placed it in grid square S-6.<ref name="Xim" />

Dravione was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by Fry and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned it was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the world was later released in [[2013]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the StarWars.com [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut — The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from ''The Essential Guide to Warfare''.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
